doc: The first-match tutorial (scripts/match/tutorial.gd). steps: [id, the one banner line]. detail: a plain-words second line under it (%X the E ability in words, %R the rank-up keys, %N the E ability's name, %U the ultimate's level, %F interact). %W swing or shoot, %J jump, %G glide, %E the E key, %T the Boki key, %s the Boki's name, %A an ability's name; the step's key shows as a key cap beside the line. alt: the line for a variant of a step (the right click with a hold, the Boki starting out). labels: the marker's caption per step. mob: how the tutorial's monsters differ from real ones (hp and size up, damage and attack tempo down). cds: the share of its usual time every ability and dash cooldown takes here (0.25 = four times quicker); each is also ready again when a step starts, is retried or its action lands. need: how many times a step's action must land, shown as 1/3 on the pill.
steps: Jump, then press %J again in the air and hold to glide
Climb up, then hold to crouch
Tap to send %s at the monster
Open the chest with the key

detail.gkey: %T is your Boki button. Tap it to send %s at a monster. Tap again to call it back. Hold it to give orders.
detail.rank: Every level gives you a skill point (see the gold + by your level). Press %R to rank up %N. Your ultimate unlocks at level %U.
detail.key: Chests are locked. Walk over the key to pick it up.
detail.chest: Chests need a key. Hold %F next to it to open it. This uses up the key.
detail.uplink: Stay inside the circle until it's yours. Step out and the capture slips back!
detail.defend: Stay inside the circle. Step out and the capture slips back!

alt.throw_send: Tap again to send %s at the monster

pell_doc: Pell, the guide (TutorialGuide): what it says when it stops you at the start of a step (one box page per line; the same %keys as the steps), and the portrait mood for steps that are not neutral.

move: I'm Pell. When the Heart broke, my soul was torn loose, and a Boki's light set me free.
Follow me. I'll show you how a Hunter gets around up here.
dash: A gap! Dash to cross it. Run from the glowing pad and dash at the edge.
exdash: This one's wider. Jump first, then dash while you're in the air.
glide: Too far to dash. Jump, then hold %G to glide across. Wings help, trust me.
crouch: Climb the lookout, then crouch. Low and still, you can see much farther.
pickup: Hunters find gear lying about. Walk over it to pick it up.
gkey: %s fights with you. Press %T to send it at a monster, and again to call it back.
rank: You levelled up! Each level is a skill point. Spend it to make an ability stronger.
shoot: A Hollow beast. These are what the broken Heart leaves behind. %W it!
sig: A whole group. That's what %A is for: line them up, then let it go.
utility: Your hunter has a trick of their own: %A. Try it on these two.
throw: That one spits from afar. Send %s at it!
orders: %s listens. Hold %T and pick an order from the wheel.
kin1: Every Boki has a power of its own. Watch %s use %A.
key: Chests up here are locked. There's a key nearby. Grab it.
chest: Now the chest. Hold next to it to open it with the key.
fight: More of them! Beat them all, you and %s together.
goexit: The outpost is this way. That's where Hunters get off an island.
uplink: Capture the uplink mast. Stay in the circle until it's yours.
defend: They're coming for the outpost! Stay in the circle and hold it.
extract: You did it. Step into the light, and I'll see you below, Hunter.
